text: Integration where the join button spins and never connects. Before Claude touches anything, it reads debug Zoom integration, a skill. MD file naming five places the failure could be: authentication, webhooks, the SDK join call, MCP transport, or the real-time media stream itself. The skill steps run in a fixed order.

title: One layer at a time
text: Check one layer, confirm it's clean, move to the next, never skip ahead, never guess which layer to check first.

title: Confirmed, then fixed
text: Auth checks out, webhooks check out, SDK join checks out. The break is in MCP transport, and only now with the layer confirmed does the skill propose a fix. Ask it about something outside those five layers, and it has nothing to add. The same steps just don't run.
